event.data_license_status: must be checked before use or redistribution

discovery_time.precision: record source value and its known precision; do not invent a time

location_wgs84.accuracy_note: record whether this is an actual reported ignition or only an incident reference point

grid.resolution_note: Record whether this is an exact ground distance or the simulator's nominal cell size.

fuel.units_and_mapping: native source fuel class to SimFire/Anderson fuel model; document unmapped classes

terrain.units_and_mapping: record elevation units, CRS, resampling and NoData treatment

weather.units_and_mapping: record time zone and conversion to simulator wind, moisture and weather inputs

fire_behavior.weather_mapping_note: not ready until verified historical weather is mapped to SimFire

references.notes: Use final perimeters only for separately labelled context/visual comparison unless a preregistered target-based objective is adopted.

limitations: Template only; not a runnable or validated case.
A reported final fire size includes the actual response and cannot be treated as an untreated-fire label.
Simulator outcomes support claims about the tested simulator, not guaranteed real-world damage reduction.
